## Purpose

What learner need or curriculum gap does this change address?

## Technical basis

- [ ] Variables, units, assumptions, and system boundary are stated where needed.
- [ ] Claims identify their evidence class and cite a permitted source.
- [ ] Examples pass a dimensional or limiting-case check where applicable.

## Source and safety review

- [ ] The change contains no material from restricted 2025 UHE or partner-lab sources.
- [ ] The change contains no student, personnel, confidential, or credential information.
- [ ] Any hardware activity retains an authorization and safety boundary.
- [ ] Any external asset has a recorded license and attribution basis.
